legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 186.
legal_units.text: The Assessing Officer may impose on a person, a penalty equal to the sum received by him in contravention of the provisions of section 186.
legal_units.context_text: Section 451 Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 186. The Assessing Officer may impose on a person, a penalty equal to the sum received by him in contravention of the provisions of section 186.
